description: Ministry of Highways & Road Development and Petroleum Resources Development - The National Thoroughfares (User Fee National Highway) Regulations
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by a Minister under the National Thoroughfares Act, No. 40 of 2008. It establishes legal requirements for user fees on national highways, specifies payment procedures, defines terms, and outlines penalties for violations. The content focuses on creating a regulatory framework rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
